instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single page React landing page in src/App.js or src/pages/LandingPage.js with clean subcomponents
Strictly follow the brand presentation data from vmig.ai (rates, prices, 1 mig = 1 sec, slideshow unlimited, contacts vmig.ai@mail.ru)
Use dark background #070709 with rose/red accent #E11D48 for buttons and primary badges
Include clear interactive elements: Form with validation submitting data to vmig.ai@mail.ru with Sonner notification
Ensure responsive bento grid for problem and feature sections
Add data-testid to all buttons, form inputs, navigation links, and tariff cards

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to every interactive component (e.g., data-testid='submit-lead-form', data-testid='tariff-card-pro')
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner for form feedback and copying email
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rules: Always ensure text on rose/red buttons is crisp white or dark depending on background
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_first: Ensure mobile menu and mobile view for pricing grid works seamlessly
